items.headline: Thiel's Founders Fund Buys $5M of $ANVIL Tokens
items.summary: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund led a $5M token purchase in crypto collateral protocol Anvil, a rare direct VC token buy signaling conviction in the DeFi collateral niche.

items.headline: $STX: Muneeb Ali Pledges IP Transfer to Stacks Endowment
items.summary: New Stacks Labs CEO Muneeb Ali pledged to transfer IP to the Stacks Endowment and unveiled a two-year roadmap covering Bitcoin privacy and post-quantum tech, with a holder call in 30 days.

items.headline: Pudgy-Backed L2 Abstract Shuts Down, $PENGU Ecosystem Hit
items.summary: Abstract, the Ethereum L2 backed by Pudgy Penguins, is winding down after losing tens of millions of dollars — a blow to the $PENGU ecosystem's chain ambitions.

items.headline: $MET: Meteora Launches DLMM Pro AMM on Solana
items.summary: MeteoraAG unveiled DLMM Pro, a new AMM design aimed at boosting liquidity efficiency on Solana — a fresh DeFi primitive from one of the chain's busiest DEX teams.

items.headline: $ZRX: 0x Swap Volume Hits $10B Milestone
items.summary: 0xProject's swap volume crossed $10B with confirmation of Arbitrum support, marking a major growth milestone for the veteran DEX infrastructure protocol.
